contract.description: Write a byte-correct Mitsubishi GX Works2 GLOBAL-LABEL CSV (labels.csv) from a structured label plan. The tool validates the plan, then writes UTF-16LE+BOM, TAB-separated quoted cells and LF line endings with the current 11-column GX Works2 label header, avoiding the partial-information warning caused by legacy 7-column files. Use it for FX ST projects where labels.csv maps variable names to devices. If validation fails, no file is written; repair the diagnostics and retry. X/Y addresses are octal. FX2/FX3 special relays use M8xxx (M8002 first scan, M8013 1 s clock); never use the newer SMxxx area. labels.csv must stay in sync with main.st.

labels.description: Label definitions: each entry is {name, device?, data_type?, constant?, address?, comment?, class?}.

address.description: IEC %-form address (e.g. %IX1); usually empty for FX Simple projects.

constant.description: Value for a compile-time constant label; else empty.

data_type.description: IEC type name (BOOL/INT/WORD/…); defaults to BOOL.

device.description: Physical device address (X0/Y0/M100/D200); empty = auto-assign. X/Y are octal. FX2/FX3 special relays are M8xxx (for example M8002), not SMxxx.

path.description: Destination path for the labels CSV (e.g. 'labels.csv'); written as UTF-16LE+BOM on success.

project_name.description: Optional project/title cell for row 1 (defaults to the real GX placeholder '(工程未设置)').

contract.name: mitsubishi_label_csv_generate
